item.title: CPD: Man arrested in connection to the December 2024 murder of his nephew
item.description: CHESAPEAKE, Va. (WAVY)-- Police in Chesapeake have arrested a man in connection to the 2024 murder of his nephew. item.title: Winter storm warning, blizzard conditions possible
item.description: The National Weather Service has issued a winter storm warning for northeastern North Carolina and southeastern Virginia, saying blizzard conditions are possible, with wind gusts of 50 to 60 mph and snow accumulations between 7 to 12 inches expected.
